name: Roberto Horowitz
title: Professor; James Fife Endowed Chair; Director, Autonomy, Robotics, and Control Lab
fitReason: Current ARC Lab centers learning, estimation and feedback for robots; directly advised work combines learned stopping, reach-avoid value estimation and physical humanoid execution.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 2026 Safe-Stop evaluates a learned stop policy and two stoppability estimators on a physical Unitree G1: five representative clips with 30 attempted repetitions each. Hardware failures are inferred from 50 Hz predictor traces because robot pose was not logged, so these are not independent motion-capture outcome labels. The large OOD success and false-approval headline metrics belong to simulated evaluations. The paper explicitly credits Horowitz with equal advising, and the current ARC roster independently lists lead author Junfeng Long as a PhD student since 2025. The fallback is simple damping; no universal emergency-stop safety guarantee or visitor robot access is established.

shortVisit.summary: ARC roster lists past visiting scholars in 2022–24 and an empty current Visiting Scholars section. No explicit open external-master short-visit invitation found. The July 2025 soft-robotics visitor notice in the separate Tomizuka Mechanical Systems Control lab is not transferred to Horowitz.

scoreReasons.fit: Substantive current safe RL, learned value estimation and robotic control.
scoreReasons.physical: Actual current G1 deployment with both explicit project advising and independent current PhD roster linkage; hardware-label limitation preserved.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Only past scholar precedent; no qualifying current visitor invitation.
scoreReasons.freshness: September 2026 primary hardware paper and current official faculty/lab pages.

name: Hongsheng He
title: Associate Professor; Director, Autonomous Robotics Laboratory
fitReason: Strong physical AI fit through executed contextual-reward-machine PPO grasping and language-to-formal-plan multi-robot research.

physicalEvidence.summary: December 2025 CRM-PPO paper executes task-oriented grasping on a dual-UR5e/Husky platform using a Schunk SVH hand, force-sensing glove and RealSense D435 with FoundationPose. It reports 60 physical tests across six affordances after 300 fine-tuning episodes, separate from 1,000 simulated tests. MoveIt2 supplies IK/collision avoidance; manually chosen force thresholds halt fingers and unsupported force/torque observations are zeroed, so transfer is not unmodified end-to-end autonomy. Current ARL roster links coauthors Akhlak Uz Zaman and Hui Li to the directed group. Separate HiP-CL executes locomotion primitives on three Leo Rovers; abstract sampling/analysis actions are not evidence of physical sample manipulation.

shortVisit.summary: Current ARL team page labels two master students as Visiting Students, without dates or appointment details. Live hiring advertises traditional/online PhD programs, and Connect is general contact only. No explicit current external-master eight-week offer or summer 2027 capacity verified.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct learned dexterous manipulation and neurosymbolic multi-robot planning, with practical embodiment.
scoreReasons.physical: Primary executed PPO grasping plus current PI/lab-student linkage; algorithmic and manual components are explicit.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Master visitors are precedent only; positive institutional policy is not a laboratory vacancy.
scoreReasons.freshness: December 2025 physical PPO preprint, 2026 HiP-CL publication and current official faculty/ARL pages.
